FUJIKI Nobuaki
授業科目の学習・教育目標
educationalGoal: Machine drafting represents a machine with the shape and features imagined by the designer in a drawing that conforms to standards, and at the same time has the role of transmitting the design to a third party through the drawing. In this course, you will learn how to design parts based on the accepted standards of mechanical drafting. You will also learn how to specify tolerances, and how to translate the three-dimensional shape of parts to two-dimensional drawings.
advice:
In this lecture, you will learn the JIS standards that are the basis of mechanical drafting and you will learn drafting methods related to accuracy and tolerance through a combination of lectures and exercises.
In each class there will be a lecture during the first half and exercises during the second half, but the drafting of the assignments that are given does not end with the exercise time during the lecture. Review is necessary. As a prerequisite, you must know the handwritten drawing preparation procedure taught in "Mechanical Drawing I".
It is necessary to thoroughly review the basic operation methods of CAD from “Mechanical drawing I” before taking this lecture.
The contents handled in this lecture are as follows.
・ Outline of JIS standards for drawing creation and CAD operation methods specialized for mechanical drawing
・ Relationship between dimensional tolerance and geometric tolerance
・ Surface roughness   ・ Dimension filling method  ・ Bolts and nuts  ・ Keys and keyways
・ Cross sections ・ Gear basics and design machine elements such as bearings
・ Drawing mechanical parts and assembly drawings with gear pumps and flanged fixed shaft joints

requiredKnowledge:
(1) You can draw on the CAD software drawing creation screen. Your ability should be at a level where it is easy to create a model of the text. Basically, items that should have been learned in Mechanical Drawing I (functions written in the text, drawing methods) are not taught in this course.
(2) 3D (3D objects) can be modeled using 3D drafting, the 3rd angle method (2D drafting) and using two-dimensional drafting (plan view, front view, side view). (3) You have mastered the method of downloading materials and uploading reports using the student portal.

activityGoals.body: Be able to transmit a design using mechanical drawing.
Be able to draw a two-dimensional mechanical drawing from a bird's-eye view or a photograph of the machine parts
Be able to imagine the shape of a part drawn from a two-dimensional mechanical drawing created by a third party.
Be able to indicate the machine design, tolerance, and accuracy for the manufacturing method of machine parts.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) 2D drawings can be drawn with CAD software and by hand, and explain them to third parties.
(2) Can recognize outlines, hidden lines, etc., necessary for developing a bird's-eye view of shafts and gears into a two-dimensional drawing.
(3) 3D-draftings can be drawn and explained from a two-dimensional drawing.
(4) With reference to the text Mechanical Drawing, the correct shape can be drawn.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) 2D drawings can be drawn with CAD software and by hand.
(2) Can recognize outlines, hidden lines, etc. and express the shape in the drawing.
(3) Can draw a bird's-eye view from a 2D drawing
(4) With reference to the text Mechanical Drawing,under given conditions and can draw the shapes.

lessons.content:
Review dimensional tolerances, fits, and
surface roughnesses learned in Mechanical
Drawing I.

Review contents
・ Dimensional tolerance, fit
・ Standard dimensions, dimensional tolerance,
etc.
・ Functional dimensions, non-functional
dimensions, reference dimensions
・ Explanation of IT tolerance and how to read
a dimensional tolerance table
・ Learn about surface roughness in specific
mechanical drawings based on the outline
explanation of Mechanical Drawing I.
・ Explain how to measure surface roughness.
・ Learn about the relationship between
machine manufacturing and processing methods
and surface roughness.

Dimensional tolerance indication method in
CAD software
・ Review the dimensional tolerance indication
method in mechanical drawing.

Surface roughness indication method with CAD
software

machine drawing.
・ Learn how to insert surface roughness with
CAD software.

Drafting exercise

④ and fill in the dimensions and tolerances.
・ Download the drawing of the gear pump ③
and⑧ from the student portal and add
dimensional tolerances to it.

"Check back"
・ Confirm how to interpret 3D figures based
on specific issues

              Machine drafting represents a machine with the shape and features imagined by the designer in a drawing that conforms to standards, and at the same time has the role of transmitting the design to a third party through the drawing. In this course, you will learn how to design parts based on the accepted standards of mechanical drafting. You will also learn how to specify tolerances, and how to translate the three-dimensional shape of parts to two-dimensional drawings.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              In this lecture, you will learn the JIS standards that are the basis of mechanical drafting and you will learn drafting methods related to accuracy and tolerance through a combination of lectures and exercises.
In each class there will be a lecture during the first half and exercises during the second half, but the drafting of the assignments that are given does not end with the exercise time during the lecture. Review is necessary. As a prerequisite, you must know the handwritten drawing preparation procedure taught in "Mechanical Drawing I".
It is necessary to thoroughly review the basic operation methods of CAD from “Mechanical drawing I” before taking this lecture.
The contents handled in this lecture are as follows.
・ Outline of JIS standards for drawing creation and CAD operation methods specialized for mechanical drawing
・ Relationship between dimensional tolerance and geometric tolerance
・ Surface roughness   ・ Dimension filling method  ・ Bolts and nuts  ・ Keys and keyways
・ Cross sections ・ Gear basics and design machine elements such as bearings
・ Drawing mechanical parts and assembly drawings with gear pumps and flanged fixed shaft joints

Reference books: None   Reserved books: None

              (1) You can draw on the CAD software drawing creation screen. Your ability should be at a level where it is easy to create a model of the text. Basically, items that should have been learned in Mechanical Drawing I (functions written in the text, drawing methods) are not taught in this course.
(2) 3D (3D objects) can be modeled using 3D drafting, the 3rd angle method (2D drafting) and using two-dimensional drafting (plan view, front view, side view). (3) You have mastered the method of downloading materials and uploading reports using the student portal.
